answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and joins a Semaphore tree under a hidden identity. It evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing its rate-limit share with a polynomial identity commitment and producing RLN proofs for messages. A duplicate nullifier signals reuse; Shamir secret sharing then reconstructs the private key, enabling instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus each stake-backed identity remains unique across the sonnet, lagoon, and haven.
